1840company-1840-company:lever:068b6273-.title: Customer Support Representative
1840company-1840-company:lever:068b6273-.description: We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Customer Support Representative to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing customer inquiries and ensuring timely and effective resolutions through various communication channels. This is a part time employment only. Shift Schedule: EST
responsibilities: Respond promptly to customer inquiries via email, messaging platforms, website chat, and social media messages.
Manage and resolve customer issues through our ticketing system, Zendesk, ensuring all communications are logged accurately.
Provide professional and empathetic support to customers, addressing product inquiries, order updates, troubleshooting, and general questions.
Collaborate with other departments to resolve complex issues and escalate cases when necessary.
Monitor and manage social media messages and comments, providing timely responses that align with the company’s tone and values.
Assist with processing returns, exchanges, and refunds, adhering to company policies.
Identify recurring issues and suggest process improvements to enhance the customer experience.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of The Gears Clock products and services to provide accurate information to customers.
qualifications: 2-3 years of proven experience in customer support, using Zendesk as a ticketing system.
Excellent written communication skills with a professional and empathetic tone.
Ability to multitask and manage multiple communication channels simultaneously.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Familiarity with social media platforms and online chat systems.
Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment.
Availability to work full-time, including occasional weekends or holidays if required.
Experience in e-commerce or retail customer support.
Knowledge of timepieces or a passion for creative and artistic products.
Familiarity with social media management tools.

angellist-angellist:lever:11a148b4-0ec0-.title: Marketing Lead
angellist-angellist:lever:11a148b4-0ec0-.description: Why Join AngelList We’re solving some of the hardest problems in venture capital and private markets. You’ll work with a team that values precision, urgency, and long-term thinking. If you want to shape how startups are funded and built, this is the place. About AngelList We exist to accelerate innovation by increasing the number of successful startups in the world. We do this by building the financial infrastructure that makes it easier for more people to invest in world-changing companies. AngelList is the nexus of venture capital and the startup community. We support $171B+ in assets and have powered investments into over 13,000 startups—over 300 of which are unicorns. Today, 57% of top-tier U.S. VC deals involve investors on AngelList. While our scale is large, our ambition is larger. If you're excited to build the future of private markets, come build with us. About the Role: AngelList supports more than $200B in assets across 30,000+ funds and syndicates, with over $80B moved through our banking infrastructure. Our network includes 2,300+ GPs and 72,000+ LPs, and more than a decade of private-market transaction data sits underneath the platform. The opportunity now is to turn that scale, knowledge, and customer trust into a stronger market position and a durable source of growth. We are looking for a senior, hands-on marketing leader to build the positioning, launch rhythm, campaigns, and distribution behind AngelList’s businesses. You’ll start with Funds. AngelList supports everything from a founder’s first SPV to $500M institutional funds, but many of the firms we want to serve next formed their view of us years ago, when AngelList was best known as where emerging managers got started. Your first challenge is to change that perception without losing what made the brand valuable. Nova, the banking network underpinning private markets, comes next. You’ll work directly with Product on what we are building and why it matters, with Sales on why important deals are won and lost, and with the GMs and operators who know our customers best. Your job is to turn what AngelList knows into positioning, proof, and programs that change how the market sees us—and ultimately change customer behavior, pipeline, and revenue. This is a player-coach role. You’ll manage a growth marketer, lead contractors across SEO, production, and creative, and build the team as your work earns further investment. This is a role for a doer: you’ll write the positioning, build the campaigns, talk to customers, and lead important launches yourself. For the right marketer, it is a rare amount of leverage.

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:357.description: At Backcountry, our mission is to connect people to their passions. Our five online stores—Backcountry, Level Nine Sports, Competitive Cyclist, MotoSport, and SteepandCheap—aim to supply our customers with the gear, knowledge, and inspiration necessary to get out there and chase down life’s greatest moments. We do this by providing the biggest and best assortment of premium outdoor products, a superior shopping experience, personalized Gearhead expertise, lightning-fast and accurate fulfillment, and inspirational, informative, and community-centered content. The ideal candidate should have a passion for outdoor activities and possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills. We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic Gearhead (Sales Associate) to join our retail team. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing exceptional customer service, generating sales, and helping customers find the right outdoor gear and apparel for their needs.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:2d8e1757-1350-.title: Affiliate Manager (GCC)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:2d8e1757-1350-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Affiliate Manager (GCC) based in India. As Affiliate Manager, you will lead player acquisition across the Gulf region, with a strong focus on driving high-quality First Time Depositors (FTDs) and sustainable revenue growth. You’ll own acquisition strategy across GCC markets and work across affiliates, paid media, influencers, SEO, and strategic partnerships. The role combines commercial ownership with hands-on performance marketing, requiring a strong understanding of regional player behavior and acquisition dynamics. You’ll build valuable relationships with affiliates, agencies, publishers, and other strategic partners while continuously optimizing campaign performance. Working closely with CRM, Product, BI, Content, Compliance, and Design teams, you’ll help turn market insights into effective acquisition initiatives. This is a high-impact opportunity to shape regional growth within a fast-paced, global, and performance-driven environment. Own and execute the player acquisition strategy across GCC markets, with a clear focus on FTD, revenue, and sustainable growth targets. Develop, launch, manage, and optimize acquisition campaigns across affiliates, paid media, influencers, SEO, strategic partnerships, and other relevant channels. Identify new acquisition opportunities, emerging channels, and innovative approaches to accelerate growth across the region. Build and maintain strong commercial relationships with affiliate partners, media agencies, publishers, influencers, and other key stakeholders. Monitor and optimize campaign performance using metrics including player quality, CPA, ROI, LTV, FTDs, revenue, and conversion rates. Manage acquisition budgets and ensure marketing spend is allocated efficiently to maximize commercial returns. Collaborate with CRM, Product, BI, Content, Compliance, and Design teams to improve campaign effectiveness and player conversion. Apply local market knowledge and consumer insights to ensure campaigns are culturally relevant and aligned with GCC player behavior. Analyze competitor activity, market developments, acquisition strategies, and customer trends to identify new growth opportunities. Prepare regular performance reports, forecasts, and actionable strategic recommendations for senior management. Continuously evaluate acquisition performance and adjust channel, partner, and budget strategies based on data and commercial results. Requirements 4+ years of experience in acquisition, performance marketing, affiliate marketing, or growth marketing within the iGaming industry. Proven track record of driving meaningful player acquisition and FTD growth across GCC markets. Strong understanding of affiliate marketing, paid acquisition, digital marketing, and performance-led growth strategies. Experience negotiating and managing CPA, Revenue Share, Hybrid, and other commercial partnership models. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into effective business decisions. Highly commercial mindset with strong negotiation, relationship-building, and partner management capabilities. Experience using acquisition platforms, analytics solutions, marketing technologies, and performance measurement tools. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple functions. Fluent English is required; Arabic language skills are highly desirable. An established network of GCC affiliates, agencies, media partners, or influencers is a strong advantage. Experience launching or scaling casino brands in regulated or emerging markets is a plus. Strong understanding of GCC player acquisition trends and regional payment ecosystems is advantageous. Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced, and performance-driven environment. Benefits Fully remote, full-time

jobgether-jobgether:lever:c782f8d0-0dd3-.title: PR Lead
jobgether-jobgether:lever:c782f8d0-0dd3-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a PR Lead based in France. This is a senior individual contributor role with ownership of the public relations strategy for an ambitious, fast-growing AI and creator technology business. You’ll shape how the brand, products, technology, and creators are positioned across influential media and cultural conversations. A major focus will be on the U.S. market, making strong relationships with North American journalists essential to success. You’ll combine strategic communications planning with hands-on execution, from developing narratives and pitching stories to preparing executives for media opportunities. The role offers significant influence over brand visibility, credibility, awareness, and global expansion. You’ll work closely with senior leadership, Marketing, Product, and creator-focused teams in a highly dynamic and often ambiguous environment. It’s an exciting opportunity for a well-connected PR professional who knows how to turn emerging trends, products, and cultural moments into compelling stories. Own and execute the overall PR strategy across brand, product, technology, creators, and major company milestones. Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with influential journalists and media contacts, particularly across U.S. technology, entertainment, lifestyle, and creator economy publications. Develop and pitch compelling stories designed to secure impactful coverage in leading media outlets. Identify timely news hooks, cultural trends, emerging conversations, and reactive opportunities that align with the brand and its strategic objectives. Create high-quality communications materials, including press releases, media pitches, talking points, FAQs, briefing documents, and reactive statements. Collaborate closely with Marketing, Product, Creator Partnerships, and senior leadership to identify stories, coordinate announcements, and maximize media opportunities. Serve as a trusted media advisor to executives, founders, and creators, preparing them for interviews, public appearances, and other media engagements. Develop compelling narratives around AI, entertainment, creator technology, and emerging digital experiences. Monitor media coverage, sentiment, reach, and other PR performance indicators, using insights to refine strategy and demonstrate impact. Respond quickly and strategically to breaking news, cultural moments, and opportunities that can increase awareness and credibility. Balance long-term brand building with short-term media opportunities that generate measurable awareness, traffic, and engagement. Contribute to the expansion of the organization's international media presence as it enters new markets. Requirements: 6+ years of professional experience in public relations, communications, or a closely related field, with a strong focus on U.S. media. Established relationships with journalists and editors across consumer technology, entertainment, creator economy, culture, or lifestyle media. Demonstrated ability to secure meaningful coverage in high-profile U.S. publications. Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to create clear, persuasive, compelling, and brand-aligned communications. Strong strategic judgment and a proven ability to identify newsworthy angles, cultural moments, and compelling narratives. Demonstrated track record of delivering measurable PR and media results. Ability to operate as both a strategic communications leader and hands-on PR practitioner, personally writing pitches, developing materials, pursuing stories, and managing relationships. Excellent understanding of the U.S. media landscape and what makes stories relevant to different audiences and publications. pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:90055fa9-ef39-404.title: UI/UX Designer
pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:90055fa9-ef39-404.description: ABOUT NOMADICML Americans drive over 5 trillion miles a year, more than 500 billion of them recorded. Buried in that footage is the next frontier of machine intelligence. At NomadicML, we're building the platform that unlocks it. Our Vision-Language Models (VLMs) act as the new "hydraulic mining" for video, transforming raw footage into structured intelligence that powers real-world autonomy and robotics. We partner with industry leaders across self-driving, robotics, and industrial automation, including Zoox, Qualcomm, Boston Dynamics, and Mitsubishi Electric, to mine insights from petabytes of data that were once unusable. We've grown from zero to $508K ARR in five months at 90% gross margins, with $3M in contracted expansions. We're backed by Pear VC, BAG VC, and Scott Wu (CEO of Cognition), with angels from Google DeepMind, Microsoft, and OpenAI. NomadicML was founded by Mustafa Bal and Varun Krishnan, who met at Harvard University while studying Computer Science. Our team has built mission-critical AI systems at Snowflake, Lyft, Microsoft, Amazon, and IBM Research, holds top-tier publications at conferences like CVPR, and moves with the speed and clarity of a startup obsessed with impact. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a UX/UI Designer with strong visual taste at NomadicML. You'll be instrumental in shaping how the world's leading autonomous vehicle and robotics companies experience our spatial intelligence platform. This means translating complex technical capabilities into intuitive interfaces, crafting a visual identity that reflects the precision and sophistication of our technology, and ensuring our product messaging resonates from the very first touchpoint. Designers at NomadicML have broad creative license and the freedom to create and lead new initiatives based on your best product judgment. We expect a versatile skillset and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes across a variety of contexts. If you're energized by rapidly iterating on everything from dense product workflows to polished landing pages, this role is for you. WHAT YOU'LL DO UX UI Design: Design the end-to-end user experience of NomadicML's digital platform: designing flows for video upload, edge case discovery, search, review tools, and data export. Translate complex spatial intelligence concepts into clear, intuitive interfaces that enterprise engineers love to use. Website & Marketing: Design website landing pages, product demos, and marketing assets that communicate our capabilities to technical buyers. Work closely with marketing to bring campaigns to life across channels. Prototyping & Iteration: Rapidly explore visual designs in Figma and translate them into web-native experiences. Test usability and functionality across platforms and web interfaces. Create interactive prototypes to test ideas and communicate vision to engineering. Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with engineers to ship pixel-perfect implementations, making pragmatic trade-offs when necessary. Work with marketing to ensure brand coherence across all touchpoints. Digital Design Systems: Think systematically to build and maintain a digital design system that scales with our product and ensures a cohesive experience as we grow. Visual Identity: Lead and evolve NomadicML's visual identity. Establish and maintain visual guidelines that ensure consistency across product, web, marketing, and sales materials. Design software with an eye towards NomadicML’s unique design aesthetic. EXAMPLE PROJECTS - Design the flow, layout, and feature hierarchy for our video analysis dashboard where engineers review thousands of AI-surfaced edge cases. - Create landing pages that communicate how NomadicML turns raw driving footage into training-ready spatial intelligence. - Develop visual frameworks for presenting complex multi-sensor data and temporal reasoning in an accessible way. - Redesign our onboarding experience to reduce time-to-value for new enterp

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek a dedicated individual that is looking to advance their leadership opportunity. This individual must possess a high drive to win while maintaining the integrity to do the right thing. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You will manage a team of highly trained, optimistic Advisors, Operators, and Attendants to provide exceptional guest service in a fun, interactive atmosphere. We need an enthusiastic leader that has experience in management, and a willingness to learn the car wash industry.
